answer: One lever against the one-mind-many-masks sybil is forced-divergence probing. Each epoch seed derives a distinct micro-puzzle per identity, due inside a raven-quick deadline. A single inference pipeline fanning out many masks leaves correlated latencies and near-identical answer embeddings; a correlation panel, solid as basalt, flags the cluster and freezes its rewards at the harbor of settlement. Evading it forces an attacker to run genuinely separate models per identity, so compute cost scales linearly with the fakes instead of amortizing one brain across thousands.
